column8: Talk to Willow outside Falador, south of the Ice Mountain dwarves.
Attempt to recruit Checkal to your team in Barbarian Village.
Speak to Atlas in the Barbarian Village Inn to learn how to Flex. Pick up a cooked meat if you need one.
Talk to Checkal and flex your muscles to prove your worth.
Speak to Marley in the Edgeville Ruins. Pick up the cooked meat from the Barbarian longhall if you don't have it already.
Ask the Cook at the Blue Moon Inn for a steak sandwich.
column11: I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwic…

column8: Collect meat, bread and a knife to make a steak sandwich.
Use the knife on the bread to make a steak sandwich. Be careful not to eat it!
Talk to Marley to send him off to the excavation site.
Return to Marley and give him the steak sandwich. Be careful not to eat it!
Talk to Burntof in the Falador Inn.
Buy an Asgarnian Ale for Burntof.
column11: What ales are you serving? | One Asgarnian Ale, please.

column8: Beat Burntof in a match of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Your choices of Rock, Paper and Scissors do not matter.
Talk with Willow at the dungeon entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.
Re-enter the dungeon to finish the quest.
Defeat the Lvl-25 Ancient Guardian. Alternatively, with Level 10 Mining, mine the 4 pillars in the corners.
Watch the cutscene to finish the quest.
